}}'''Lamelle''' was a [[Far Dareis Mai]] from the [[Smoke Water]] sept of the [[Miagoma]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lamelle}} She treated [[Rand al'Thor]] as a son and cooked soup for him all the time even though she was a terrible cook.

== Appearance ==
She was a strong jawed [[Aiel]] with dark red hair.

== Activities ==
She was part of the ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' bodyguard that surrounds Rand when he meets all the nobles in [[Cairhien]] after the [[Shaido]] attack. She went with the attack force that confronts [[Rahvin]]'s forces in [[Caemlyn]] and was killed during the battle.
